description: This file defines the interface IAVInput for managing audio/video input devices, configurations, notifications, and various input-related operations within a media application. It includes multiple nested notification structures and methods for device management, configuration, and property retrieval.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for managing AV input devices, configurations, and notifications, supporting various operations like device configuration, input management, EDID control, and notification registration.

classes.name: InputDevice
classes.description: Represents an input device with id, locator, and connection status.

classes.name: SuccessResult
classes.description: Represents the success status of an operation.

classes.name: IDevicesChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for when input devices change.

classes.name: ISignalChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for signal status changes.

classes.name: IVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification for HDMI/Composite video stream info updates.

classes.name: IGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification for game feature status updates.

classes.name: IAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification for AV Infoframe content type updates.

methods.description: Configures the input device with the given shell service.

methods.description: Returns the number of available input devices.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Retrieves the current EDID value for a specified port.

methods.description: Gets the raw SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI input.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Gets the SPD infoFrame for a specified HDMI input.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a port.

methods.description: Sets VRR support in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Retrieves VRR support info from EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Gets the maximum HDMI version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specific input port.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current input source.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if the content is protected.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Returns the list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific game feature.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
